name: Example: Custom Camera Presets
description: Edit the titles and prompts to build your own library. Category is optional.

presets.title: 2003 | Nightclub with harsh flash
presets.prompt: A spontaneous low-quality nightclub snapshot taken with a very early mobile phone camera around 2003. A harsh frontal flash blows out faces and nearby reflective surfaces while the background fades into near-black. Very low pixel count, crude JPEG compression, unstable colors, visible noise, weak focus and clumsy framing make the image feel like a genuine personal photo.

presets.title: 2006 | Fluorescent office
presets.prompt: A candid 2006 camera-phone snapshot under unflattering overhead fluorescent lights. The cheap sensor produces a green-yellow color cast, muddy shadows and weak texture, with slight hand motion, soft focus and compressed JPEG edges. The image looks unplanned, plain and visibly low quality.

presets.title: 2004 | Budget digital compact
presets.prompt: An ordinary point-and-shoot photo from a cheap digital compact camera around 2004. Slightly oversaturated CCD colors, softened edges from a budget lens, brittle in-camera sharpening, imperfect automatic exposure and a modest amount of JPEG artifacts. Casual, unposed personal photography rather than an intentional retro look.

presets.title: 2005 | Low-resolution webcam
presets.prompt: A low-resolution still image captured by an inexpensive USB webcam around 2005. Flat perspective from a fixed desk position, soft and waxy detail, noticeable compression blocks, awkward automatic white balance, noisy dark areas and uneven monitor-lit illumination. Unpolished personal-computer snapshot quality.

presets.title: 1997 | Disposable camera scan
presets.prompt: A casual personal snapshot from a 1990s disposable film camera, scanned from a small consumer print. Soft plastic-lens corners, direct flash falloff, uneven exposure, modest film grain, muted detail and slightly faded print colors. Natural flaws of an inexpensive one-use camera rather than a digitally applied vintage filter.
